envelope.description: Add per-(type,model) JSON Schema transformers for SecurityFinding and SecurityLocator

body.title: Add per-(type,model) JSON Schema transformers for SecurityFinding and SecurityLocator
body.summary: Add bidirectional JSON Schema transformers (canonical model -> a shape a given (type, target model) pair reliably emits against, and back) for SecurityFinding and SecurityLocator, extending the pattern already used for the codex provider, so the union/inheritance-heavy shapes added by t1/t2 are safely presentable to structured-output LLM calls.
acceptanceChecks: A per-(type,model) JSON Schema transformer exists for SecurityFinding, covering its kind discriminant and inherited Finding fields
A per-(type,model) JSON Schema transformer exists for SecurityLocator, covering its kind discriminant and inherited Locator fields

tests.name: JSON Schema transformer output for SecurityFinding (kind discriminant + inherited Finding fields)
JSON Schema transformer output for SecurityLocator (kind discriminant + inherited Locator/Pointer fields)
